law: You can then use Core Spotlight to search for your indexed content and display those results in your app.
Spotlight File Import extensions don’t provide functionality in macOS.
Devices don’t share indexed data with Apple, or synchronize that data with the person’s other devices.

In addition to indexing content, iOS provides additional strategies for making your app’s content searchable: Use the search-related properties of to add items to the on-device index, with the option to identify the items as eligible for public indexing.
Use web markup to index content on your web server in Apple’s server-side index, which makes the data available to all iOS users in Spotlight and Safari search results.
When indexing your app’s content, use a named index.
